name: Launch pad
blurb: Where and when the ship leaves Earth, and the equipment that holds it until it does.

slots.name: Tomorrow 06:10
slots.note: Clear and cold. No waiting, no fees.

equipment.name: Hold-down clamps
equipment.role: Hold the ship on the pad until every engine is at full thrust.

options.name: No hold-down (release at ignition)
options.note: The ship lifts as soon as thrust exceeds weight, whatever the engines are doing.
cons: A failing engine is found out in the air

options.name: Hold-down clamps
options.note: Clamps hold the ship for a few seconds while the computer checks every engine; a bad start shuts down on the pad.
pros: Catches bad starts on the ground
options.real: Saturn V hold-down arms, Falcon 9 clamps

equipment.name: Sound suppression water
equipment.role: A flood of water under the engines that soaks up the roar.

options.name: No water
options.note: The sound of the engines reflects off the pad and shakes the ship.

options.name: Water deluge
options.note: Hundreds of tonnes of water in seconds: the white cloud at every Shuttle launch was steam.
